newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Five Russian workers die of methane poisoning.
newsitem.headline: Five Russian workers die of methane poisoning.

text.p: Five workers have died of methane poisoning during maintanance works at a community sewage system in a southern Russian village, Interfax news agency said on Saturday.
The agency quoted local emergency officials as saying that the incident in the Krasnodar region on Friday was caused by neglect of safety measures by the workers.
